dataset: Honda R&D Europe industrial facility energy dataset, Dryad DOI 10.5061/dryad.73n5tb363
primary_task: At 13:00 Europe/Berlin on D-1, forecast every physical 15-minute signed-grid-exchange interval of local calendar day D.

missing_history_policy.canonical_representation: NaN plus explicit availability indicator where appropriate
missing_history_policy.model_specific_adapter: Allowed later if leakage-safe, explicit, audited, and does not alter the canonical target set
missing_history_policy.common_context_subset: Allowed only for strict pairwise architecture comparisons; never replaces canonical evaluation

structural_sensitivity_folds.name: POST_2020_STRUCTURAL_SENSITIVITY
structural_sensitivity_folds.purpose: Assess robustness to excluding fragmented and structurally unusual 2020; must not replace P1 based on TEST scores

test_access_guard.reopening_rule: Requires explicit new protocol version and scientific justification

complete_day_rule: Every physical interval of the local day is primary eligible
complete_sensitivity_day_rule: Every physical interval is OBSERVED_ORIGINAL or CORRECTED_NONIMPUTED
partial_day_rule: Retain every primary-eligible interval in headline interval metrics; exclude incomplete days only from complete-day profile and default optimization analyses

bridge_day_rule.definition: Non-holiday Monday-Friday with one adjacent local date a public holiday and the other adjacent local date a weekend day

structural_era_policy.PV_CAPACITY_ERA: EVALUATION_STRATUM; documented engineering dates may be future-safe
structural_era_policy.POST_MODERNIZATION_2023: EVALUATION_ONLY; 2023-06-01 through 2023-12-31 local; month precision; no causal claim
structural_era_policy.CHP_CONTROL_BOUNDARY_UNCERTAIN: EVALUATION_ONLY; official sources disagree between 2019-02-13 and 2019-02-19; not a predictive feature

M1: pre-issuance historical thermal variables where provenance allows

baseline_definitions.B0: Most recent completed provenance-safe grid value at issuance, held constant over target day
baseline_definitions.B1: Most recent preceding local calendar day with provenance-safe matching local quarter-hour; repeated-hour fold/offset must match; missing if none
baseline_definitions.B2: Same local quarter-hour exactly seven local calendar days earlier when safe and completed; repeated-hour fold/offset must match; otherwise missing
baseline_definitions.B3: Median same local quarter-hour from prior N eligible calendar weeks; N in {2,4,8} selected on development folds only
baseline_definitions.B4: Training-only robust calendar climatology; grouping selected on development folds, candidate month x weekday/weekend x local quarter-hour
baseline_definitions.B5: Simple ensemble of selected baselines only when development-fold evidence justifies it; rule frozen before TEST

near_zero_tolerance.basis: No defensible nonzero metering tolerance documented; future sensitivity tolerance must be predefined without TEST tuning

model_selection_rule.aggregation: Concatenate all eligible 2021 Fold-A and 2022 Fold-B validation targets and compute one MAE, giving equal weight to every eligible target interval

final_refit_rule: After P1 development selection, refit once on eligible 2020-2022 data and evaluate 2023 once; P2 may separately refit on 2021-2022
pairwise_comparison_rule: Use common eligible targets and common complete days; report paired mean error difference, whole-day bootstrap 95% CI, daily win rate, and common target/day counts
probabilistic_test_rule: Use the same 2023 TEST and target rules; calibration uses chronological development data only; 2023 calibration is forbidden; exact calibration design requires a separately versioned extension
coherent_scenario_requirement: Downstream stochastic optimization requires temporally coherent daily trajectories; marginal quantiles alone are insufficient
market_timing_note: Forecast issuance stays 13:00 D-1; a later verified price-publication/decision timestamp may be slightly later without changing forecast issuance
cross_dataset_note: Honda signed net grid exchange is not equivalent to SPARK gross/site consumption-like demand; raw kW MAE is not a fair cross-site comparison
